The webhook delivery workers do not consume from NATS or RabbitMQ.

The mechanism is an in-process Go channel. Four goroutine workers consume from `asyncPostQueue` in `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` at line 39. The queue is declared with capacity 128 and the workers are started in `init()`.

The repository is github.com/usememos/memos.

Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. The webhook delivery mechanism relies on an in-process buffered Go channel named `asyncPostQueue` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It is declared at line 39 with capacity 128. Four goroutine workers are started in `init()` at lines 42–55. Producers call `webhook.PostAsync()` from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`.
